CP KIDS

welcome to CP Kids

Please take a look at our welcome video for a brief introduction to what it's like! 

When visiting each Sunday please check your kids in at the check-in station before each scheduled service - Sundays at 9:00 and 11:00am.  Children ages 0-3rd grade can be checked in before the service begins, and escorted by a parent to their classrooms immediately.

4th and 5th graders will join the adults in the sanctuary to experience morning worship and just before the sermon, they will be dismissed to head to their classroom for an engaging, age-appropriate lesson. 


We look forward to having your kiddos with us!

NURSERY

0-12 month nursery
1-2 year old nursery
While you enjoy the service, our dedicated volunteer teams will look after your child. You get to decide exactly how we handle diaper changes and snack time. If your child needs you for any reason, we will contact you right away.

PK & KINDERGARTEN

3 year olds
Pre-K
Our leaders will help each child experience God’s love through hands-on activities, worship, and Bible stories designed just for their curious and playful hearts.

KIDS CHURCH

K-3rd grade
4-5 grade
Your kids will dive into God’s Word through fun lessons, engaging worship, and small groups that helps each child grow in their faith and friendships.

KEEP KIDS SAFE
WITH CHECK-IN

We use Planning Center to keep your kids safe and secure.

Every volunteer is background checked and trained before serving.  All kids' areas have a secure check-in before service.
The first time you bring your kids to a service, our volunteers will help you get started, but then it's really simple. You can check in using just the last 4 digits of your phone number!

Or check in before you even leave your car with our system's mobile app. Download the app, then search for Crosspoint Lynchburg to get started.
